subject.title: feat(gateway): session dashboard domain — board RPCs, ticketed widgets, dashboard tool, per-agent persistence

question: Should the dashboard protocol support persisted MCP-app widgets in this core gateway surface now, and if so what authorized client reconstruction contract should be permanent?
rationale: The branch declares MCP-app widgets as a first-class stored content kind, but the current gateway snapshot does not provide a renderable descriptor or ticketed view. Choosing whether to omit that kind for now, expose a descriptor, or add a distinct resource contract is an enduring protocol and security-boundary decision.

options.title: Narrow this PR to HTML widgets
options.body: Remove the MCP-app persisted widget path from this PR and land the proven HTML board contract first, leaving a separately designed MCP-app integration for later.

options.title: Define an authorized MCP-app contract
options.body: Keep MCP-app widgets only after documenting and implementing a stable, appropriately scoped descriptor or resource-serving contract with focused client and gateway proof.

options.title: Pause the server-domain feature
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers confirm the full dashboard content model and its long-term protocol ownership.

recommendation.title: Narrow this PR to HTML widgets
recommendation.body: Remove the MCP-app persisted widget path from this PR and land the proven HTML board contract first, leaving a separately designed MCP-app integration for later.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged UI board foundation and the current gateway-domain proposal, so they have the strongest available context for the cross-surface contract.
